chart.name: Server overview
chart.programText:
A = data('agentgateway_requests_total', filter=filter('protocol', 'llm')).sum(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).sum(by=['service.instance.id']).publish(label='A')
C = histogram('agentgateway_gen_ai_server_request_duration').count(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).sum(by=['service.instance.id']).publish(label='C')
D = data('agentgateway_requests_total', filter=filter('status', '4*', '5*') and filter('protocol', 'llm')).sum(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).sum(by=['service.instance.id']).publish(label='D')
B = histogram('agentgateway_gen_ai_client_token_usage').sum(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).sum(by=['service.instance.id']).publish(label='B')
E = histogram('agentgateway_gen_ai_client_token_usage', filter=filter('gen_ai_token_type', 'input', 'input_cache_read')).sum(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).sum(by=['service.instance.id']).publish(label='E')
F = histogram('agentgateway_gen_ai_client_token_usage', filter=filter('gen_ai_token_type', 'output')).sum(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).sum(by=['service.instance.id']).publish(label='F')
